certifications.$catalogNote: Was three flat credentials picked uniformly, which is not what a real association credential programme looks like: real ones ladder (foundation -> professional -> advanced), gate the upper rungs behind the lower ones, and vary in how long they stay valid. `level` and `prerequisite` are honoured by the generator today; they are NOT yet emitted as columns (Certification is a table we own and new columns need a migration — planned separately), so for now the ladder shows up as which credentials members actually hold and in what order. `weight` biases which credential a pursuer goes for — foundation credentials are far more common than advanced ones.

catalog.name: Cheese Foundations Certificate
catalog.description: Entry-level credential covering milk handling, basic make procedures, hygiene and cheese styles. No prerequisite; the usual first step into the federation's credential ladder.

catalog.name: Food Safety & HACCP Certificate
catalog.description: Hazard analysis, environmental monitoring and recall readiness for small and mid-sized creameries. Shortest validity in the programme: food-safety practice moves, so holders recertify every two years.

catalog.name: Certified Cheesemonger
catalog.description: Counter-side credential: cut and wrap, storage and rotation, customer guidance, and building a balanced case. Popular with retail members.

catalog.name: Certified Cheese Professional (CCP)
catalog.description: The federation's flagship professional credential. Requires documented working hours and a foundation certificate, and covers make procedures, affinage, safety and business practice end to end.

catalog.name: Sensory Evaluation Certificate
catalog.description: Structured tasting, defect identification and scoring against style standards. The usual route onto a competition judging panel.

catalog.name: Advanced Affinage Certificate
catalog.description: Advanced maturation practice: rind management, cave environment control and maturation planning across styles. Open to CCP holders.

catalog.name: Competition Judge Accreditation
catalog.description: Accreditation to judge federation competitions. Requires the sensory certificate plus supervised panel experience, and lapses quickly without active judging.

certifications.$note: pool = members with a completed course (the prerequisite); engaged completers pursue a credential. ESTIMATE (confidence: low, researched 2026-07-16 - no published take-rate exists): directionally sensible against 51% of members VALUING certifications (netforumams.com association-certifications-101) and 39% joining primarily for continuing education; I.C.E. publishes no pipeline-conversion stat.
